en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said, ‘
When the man permits for his slave that he can keep concubines from his wealth, so he can buy as many as he so desires to, after him happened to have been permitted for it’.
